integrity: Kummer carry proof with exact eight-state matrix, symbolic rational identities and independent finite digit-sum checks. Earlier parity-count OEIS recurrence and the existing four-state (3n,n) specialization are not claimed as new. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only dyadic cutoffs for the slope (5,2) at the prime 2. It determines valuation counts, not unit residues modulo prime powers. A more general unindexed digital theorem may imply the explicit identities.
title: Exact binary valuation fibres on the binomial ray \(\binom{5n}{2n}\)
